insertion_recovery_primitive — DRIVE pegfail op

• Data kinds: any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.insertion_recovery_primitive(name: 'str') -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import pegfail; pegfail.insertion_recovery_primitive(name: 'str') -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("insertion_recovery_primitive"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Table of recovery primitives (class → description of the motion). name is a recovery word of the table.

lift_recentre: raise the tip to 6 mm above the plate, measure (dx, dy) with the wrist RGB-D, shift the carriage (≤ 6 times), and descend again. lift_reapproach: raise to 10 mm above the mouth, return the carriage to the fixture's target coordinates, align with the camera, and descend again. retract_reduce_tilt: retract 4 mm, measure the wrist hinge angle and undo the grasp tilt by that amount (θ → 0), then descend again (towards θ ≤ c/μ of p.28). steer_force: evaluate the parallelogram margin with a linear model and, from the 3 × 3 combinations of a 0.5 mm lateral carriage move (F_x and M = L_g F_x move together) and a 0.5° wrist rotation (only M moves, by k_r Δ), choose the one with the largest margin; ≤ 6 steps until it advances (Whitney p.34: bring the force ratio into the diagram). lift_abort: retract and finish (an obstacle cannot be cleared by pushing). continue: do nothing. stop: done. Raises ValueError: unknown name (spelling corruption is fail-closed).
